props.heading: Week 6 — learned and open

moves.label: LEARNED
moves.detail: 512x is the gap at 262,144 tokens; at 512 tokens the state and the cache are equal.

moves.label: CHECKED
moves.detail: Decay-then-correct is the paper's update rewritten — expanded, it is eq. 10.

moves.label: OPEN
moves.detail: ClaudeScienceLayerStack and ClaudeCodeBeat still have no 9:16 twin.

moves.label: NEXT
moves.detail: Next week's teardown, built the same way.
